name: portfolio
description: Personal portfolio site. The EV tracker is a dependency-free, single-file app; these scripts are developer tooling only and produce no build output.

scripts.check: npm test && npm run fmt:check && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:markup
scripts.test:unit: node tools/test-roles.mjs && node tools/test-storage.mjs && node tools/test-bin.mjs && node tools/test-sync-status.mjs && node tools/test-location.mjs
scripts.test:markup: node tools/test-dom.mjs && node tools/test-wiring.mjs && node tools/test-i18n-markup.mjs && node tools/test-sw-bump.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run fmt
